title: Checked before anything is written
description: dream_archive reads and writes the formats. dream_archivetool decides what is safe to do with them, and does all of its deciding before the first byte lands on disk.

nodes.title: An archive, or a folder
nodes.detail: A .bsa or .ba2 to inspect or extract, or files to pack into one.

nodes.title: dream_archivetool
nodes.detail: Checks every entry path and every target, finds what already exists, refuses what it cannot rewrite without loss, and writes through a temporary file.

nodes.title: Files, or an archive
nodes.detail: Extracted files that replace nothing you did not ask to replace, or a new archive that appears in one rename.

nodes.title: dream_archive
nodes.detail: Parses and writes TES3 and TES4 BSAs and BA2s. dream_archivetool never reads an archive's bytes itself.

nodes.title: Dry runs
nodes.detail: The same checks, reported per entry as JSON, and nothing written.
